annotation.title_clean: Conceptualizing Trust in Objects of Speculation: A Narrative Approach to Robot Governance
annotation.title_en: Conceptualizing Trust in Objects of Speculation: A Narrative Approach to Robot Governance
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IOS Press (Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications, vol. 335)
annotation.venue: Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications
annotation.summary_en: Abstract of a conference paper in a volume on culturally sustainable social robotics. It treats robots as speculative objects of an emerging technology and proposes a narrative approach and a concept for analysing trust building through technology governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Robotics is an emerging technology with a speculative character and differing societal expectations.
Engaging with robots as speculative objects calls for a narrative approach to robot trajectories.
Proposes a concept for analysing trust building through technology governance.
